newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Queensland coal production expected to rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Queensland coal production expected to rise.

text.p: Queensland's Department of Mines and Energy said production of coal was expected to expand to 150 million tonnes a year in the next three years from the current 93.7 million tonnes annually.

"By the year 2000, Queensland coal production is expected to grow to 150 million tonnes annually resulting in a dramatic increase in export value over the A$4.2 billion in 1995/96," the department's director-general, Bob Day said in the latest minerals and energy review.

Coking coal exports could grow to 87 million tonnes by the end of the decade from 52 million tonnes last year, Day said. Thermal coal exports were expected to nearly double to 45 million tonnes in the same period, he said.
Queensland is Australia's biggest coal producing state.
